items.title: Cloud for Data Storage and Blockchain for Supply Chain Transparency

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Cloud for Data Storage and Blockchain for Supply Chain Transparency under 8.3 as printed (PDF 117, printed 113).

blocks.text: Cloud Computing provides scalable storage and quick access to agricultural data for farmers, researchers, and policymakers. Blockchain adds transparency to the supply chain by recording each stage of crop production and distribution, reducing fraud and ensuring fair trade. Together, these technologies create a sustainable and trustworthy agricultural ecosystem for Pakistan's future.
